title: Tree classes and fan-in-two depth
statement: For a natural number $d$ and a language $L$ over Boolean strings, if $L$ is recognized by a family of Boolean circuit trees of polynomial size and depth at most $b(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)^d$ at every input length $n$, for some natural number $b$, then $L$ is recognized by such a tree family with fan-in at most two and polynomial size, and with depth at most $b'(\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1)^{d+1}$ at every input length $n$, for some natural number $b'$.
hypotheses_covered: $L$ belongs to the tree-circuit class with parameter $d$ (polynomial size, polylogarithmic depth, and equality of the recognized language)
